title: BTCPay, a bitcoin payment tool, tells users to switch off their servers after reports of drained wallets
reason: Major security breach affecting a widely used open-source Bitcoin payment tool.

sources.summary: The open-source project says it is still investigating and hasn't given a loss figure or announced a fix. Its founder said the reports appear to involve versions older than 2.4.2.

title: Coinbase downgraded at Morgan Stanely; price target slashed 53% on weak earnings outlook
reason: Significant analyst downgrade with a 53% price target cut for a major exchange.

sources.summary: Analyst Michael Cyprys cited weak crypto trading activity and doubts about an earnings recovery.
